text:
maria: follow-up from today's security segment. collecting clarifications specifically around SOC2 vs ISO artifacts, cross-cloud audit-log exports, object-lock/retention options, and BYOK rotation proof. posting answers + owners here.

elena: short summary up front: yes we provide tailored SOC2 and ISO evidence packs; we can export audit logs to customer buckets across AWS/GCP/Azure; object-lock/WORM and cross-region replication are possible but require pre-setup; BYOK rotations are supported with import manifests and rotation proofs. details in replies.

priya: SOC2 vs ISO: SOC2 packs focus on Trust Services Criteria + sample log slices, change-history, access lists, and control test artifacts. ISO bundles include policy/risk docs, ISMS scope, and evidence maps keyed to Annex A controls. For either, include a scoped list of services (+example prompts) and evidence_owner in the compliance form: https://bit.ly/rwd-compliance. Standard turnaround = 72 hours; add 48h expedited option (SLA addon).

dan: audit-log exports: hosted tenants default to our managed bucket (s3://redwood-logs/audit/<region>/) with a delivery manifest. Private/Dedicated exports go to customer-provided buckets via a cross-account role we provision. We also support GCP (gs://) and Azure Blob exports for customers on those clouds via connectors — specify `cloud_provider` + bucket/container in the request. Default retention 90 days; options for 180/365/legal-hold available. Example export prefix: `s3://<bucket>/redwood/audit/<cluster>/YYYY/MM/DD/`

alex: question: can we enable Object Lock (WORM) + cross-region replication for evidence buckets? auditors asked about immutability + geographic redundancy.

elena: short answer: yes, but it requires the bucket to be created with Object Lock enabled up-front (cannot toggle after creation for AWS). For hosted exports we can write objects with the required headers and create manifests with timestamps; for Private we need your bucket to have Object Lock + replication configured per your org policy. if you need vendor-provided attestation (WORM + replication), we'll coordinate with legal & infra during onboarding.

priya: KMS/BYOK specifics: supported flows = AWS CMKs, imported key material (BYOK), and HSM-backed keys. For BYOK we require an import manifest and will capture import events + key usage slices (CloudTrail or equivalent). Rotation proof artifacts include: timestamped rotation event, post-rotation test encrypt/decrypt logs, and key-version mapping. If you use an external KMS with no CloudTrail, provide equivalent audit logs. HSM attestation docs are required for HSM-based custody.

dan: perms/setup practicals: for Private exports we ask you to pre-create bucket/container with minimal policy and share ARN/URL; we provide a trust policy and export role for cross-account assume. sample IAM trust snippet we'll paste into #eng-docs, e.g.:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-exporter"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```

maria: ops question: will evidence include KV/prefix cache traces and request->response correlation for sampled sessions?

elena: yes if you flag `include_cache_traces` in the compliance form. we capture a short trace window to avoid SLO impact and coordinate capture windows with your SRE/owners. include sample prompts and expected deltas so our traces match the audit scope.

priya: billing/SLAs: extended retention (180/365) may carry additional storage/ingest costs. expedited evidence packs are a billable add-on. legal-hold requests that freeze deletion must go through procurement/legal for billing & policy.

comp-bot: Created ticket COMP-5501 to track the requests/asks referenced in this thread.

alex: can we get a one-page checklist for product/security reviewers listing the exact artifacts we should gather before raising a compliance request?

dan: yes  action: I'll post a concise checklist + sample bucket policies (AWS/GCP/Azure) + example CloudTrail filters for KMS events to #eng-docs by EOD. will include a short runbook for safe cache trace capture.

elena: office hours: security + eng-platform will host a Q&A next Tue 8:30am PT (30m) to run through the one-pager and walk through a sample private export onboarding. sign-up: https://meet.redwood.ai/sec-onboard. recording + slides + a checklist spreadsheet will be attached to COMP-5501 after the session.

maria: thanks everyone. i'll collect product questions and add them to COMP-5501. if urgent, ping @priya or @dan. closing the loop for now.
